description: Find embedding models (search models) on Hugging Face that Matrix can run locally: feature-extraction repos with an ONNX export. Per repo: downloads, likes, license, languages (as the model card states them), created/last-modified dates, vector size (dimension; null = not stated, cannot be registered automatically), query/document prefixes, its graph variants with download size (e.g. model = full precision, model_q4 = int4) and image encoders (graphics search). Use it when the user asks for a better or smaller search model, or when the configured recommendation is older than six months (get_status shows its date, search_model): compare the candidates with the current model and suggest one - multilingual documents need a multilingual model. Install: setup_embedding_model with repo_id and variant. Reaches the internet; nothing is downloaded.

query.description: Part of the repo name, e.g. 'gemma', 'e5', 'bge-m3' (default: all).

name: search_embedding_models
